description: Look up one server's live status (provisioning | running | suspended | expired | destroyed), public IPv4, lease expiry (unix seconds), and bandwidth usage. Read-only — never charges money or changes the server. Use to confirm a box is up and reachable, or to see how long it has before auto-destroy.

id.description: Server id returned by provision_server, e.g. "srv_abc123".

name: get_server
title: Get server status
